The fingers on the fretboard are slightly blurry and lack distinct separation, appearing to merge slightly with the neck, a common AI artifact in complex hand poses.
The foreground heads exhibit a 'waxy' or overly smooth blur that feels more like generative smoothing than optical depth-of-field bokeh, though this is minor.
